title: md.tick.v1
description: Canonical bid/ask quote tick. Optional high-resolution substrate used for intrabar fill realism and spread/slippage capture. v1 may be bar-only; this contract reserves the tick layer so adding it later is additive. mid and spread are DERIVED.

symbol.description: Canonical symbol. Venue spellings never cross this boundary.

ts.description: Quote time in UTC, millisecond precision (e.g. 2025-05-18T21:00:03.412Z).

bid.description: Best bid at full source precision.

ask.description: Best ask at full source precision. Must be >= bid for real ticks.

mid.description: DERIVED = (bid + ask) / 2. Included for convenience; recomputable.

spread.description: DERIVED = ask - bid. >= 0 for real ticks.

synthetic.description: True when ticks are generated (e.g. replay intrabar path from a bar-only store). Consumers must never mistake synthetic ticks for captured ticks.
